name: Brill: 'Stay a While' credits only after Dark Priestess Ashara's sermon (#6330)
contract: Quest 1660054 'Stay a While' asks the player to 'Listen to Dark Priestess Ashara' (162847) through her option
'<Stay a while and listen.>' (gossip 932415). Like Aliscar Lend's lesson for 1660060, choosing it must start a
spoken sermon and credit the listen marker 162921 only after it, not at once. The sermon lines are INFERRED
(rev_20261014_60); this checks the flow: no credit 3 s after the choice, the opening and closing lines are said
to the player (SMSG_MESSAGECHAT 150, MONSTER_SAY 12 in Universal 0, so the first uint32 is 12), and the credit
follows the closing line. It does not check client chat rendering.

steps.label: the hero stays a while and listens
DISCRIMINATING: choosing the option does not credit the objective by itself
Ashara opens her sermon
steps.text: The living fill their chapels to beg the Light for comfort.

steps.label: Ashara speaks of the Three Virtues
steps.text: The Cult of the Forgotten Shadow keeps Three Virtues.

steps.label: still no credit during the sermon
Ashara closes her sermon
steps.text: You have listened longer than most.

steps.label: the objective is credited after the sermon
